5147-7084-8338.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat.

513-1778-4336.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-1778-4336.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

333-728-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-728-8207.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

3259-5734-8201.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-8201.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

5078-6766-7295-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

971-2033-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-2033-4687.description:
Activate Citanul Hierophants by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

129-1978-5793-7434.description:
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.
129-1978-5793-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

1116-1580-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-955-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-955-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

796-1618-2440-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher
796-1618-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
796-1618-2440-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

765-1558-2638-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2638-4231-6441.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

6285-7268.notablePrerequisites: You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
6285-7268.description:
Cast Kitsune's Technique by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing the opponent to mill the remainder of their library.
6285-7268.notes: If able, you can instead cast Kitsune's Technique for its sneak cost, reducing the needed mana by {3}{U}.

1621-4605-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying its mana cost.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 3.

1020-2866-5231-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1020-2866-5231-6556.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

4050-5086-5183-6441-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6441-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

930-5414-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3484-5391-6441-6774.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-5391-6441-6774.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

4289-5051-5078-5741.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

821-1385-2173-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2558-2981-3000-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3743-5089-5436-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-5436-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2921-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
2921-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2921-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1636-1689-5027.notablePrerequisites:
You've cast at least one spell this turn.
Gnostro does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-1689-5027.description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card due to Eligeth.
The Locust God triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.
If you have cast two or more spells this turn, you will get extra Intruder Alarm triggers, and in-between resolving them you may tap Gnostro to gain life and/or deal damage to creature(s).

2144-3560-3729.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
2144-3560-3729.description:
Kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
Myrkul triggers, creating a token copy of Ondu Spiritdancer that is an enchantment.
When the token Ondu Spiridancer enters the battlefield, it and Archon of Sun's Grace trigger.
Resolve the Archon of Sun's Grace trigger, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Resolve the Ondu Spiritdancer trigger, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 3.

224-2841-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
It is not your turn.
224-2841-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Scaretiller, adding one mana of any color.
Scaretiller triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Ghost Town enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1633-1908-5032-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have no other cards in hand.
You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
1633-1908-5032-5195.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least two token copies of Storm-Kiln Artist with haste.
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding Hanabi Blast.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 6.

2034-3055-3149-3747.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Child of Alara.
2034-3055-3149-3747.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Child of Alara, adding {C}{C}.
Child of Alara dies, triggering itself and Gift of Immortality.
Resolve the Child of Alara trigger, destroying all nonland permanents you don't control due to your permanents having indestructible.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Child of Alara from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of the next end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Child of Alara.
Repeat each turn.

1479-3147-4488.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-4488.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1992-2292-4381.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2292-4381.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Grumgully triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying one.
Repeat.

2665-3277-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
2665-3277-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the token Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
